zoneless_mail_equal_to_zoned_since.why: Superseded by JSA-390 (2026-11-17, row Acceptance written by the dev lead): a subject that only says 'thank you for your interest' is no receipt unless the body says the application was received; this case has no body. The old spec listed it as a receipt.
